scalars.scalar_value: This position requires a Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Accounting, IT, Education, or a related field, and five years of related experience, including three years of direct experience in the administration of grants. Master's degree in educational administration, business management, IT/Technology, or a related field is preferred .
Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.

items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?
02. Describe your experience administering grants or other externally funded projects. Include examples of how you made funding decisions to improve project outcomes while maintaining compliance.

03. This role involves developing and maintaining partnerships with educational institutions, employers, workforce organizations, etc. Describe a specific partnership you developed, your role, and the resulting benefit to students or the institution.

04. Describe your experience supervising staff or project teams. Include the types of employees supervised and how you established priorities, monitored performance, and supported professional growth.

05. Describe your experience supporting Career Education (CTE), workforce development, apprenticeship, industry partnerships, or related educational initiatives. If your experience is outside California Community Colleges, describe how it relates to career education and workforce development.

06. This is in-house-only recruitment: This position is open to active employees of the Coast Community College District (CCCD) to apply. Candidates that are not active employees of the district are NOT eligible to apply. If you are not a current employee with CCCD, please do not apply at this time. Are you currently employed by the Coast Community College District as an active employee? Options: Yes | No

08. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A complete Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume or curriculum vitae (upload as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses required, as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A," or leave blank) 4. Cover letter addressing the desirable qualifications of the position (attached as a separate document) Options: Yes | No

09. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses Options: Yes | No
May require a valid driver's license.

This position requires a Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Accounting, IT, Education, or a related field, and five years of related experience, including three years of direct experience in the administration of grants. Master's degree in educational administration, business management, IT/Technology, or a related field is preferred .
Master's degree in educational administration, business management, IT/Technology, or a related field is preferred .
Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required equivalent qualifications for the position.
Work is performed indoors where minimal safety considerations exist.

Evidence of demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students. (California Code of Regulations Title 5 53022; Education Code Section 87360; Coast Community College District EEO Plan)
